messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up  Luis's OPT EAD expires 05/20 and start date is 06/01. He requested travel 05/25-05/30. Need guidance on onboarding / benefits and travel letter.
Luis Fernandez: Hey team, small family event in Mexico. If I travel after my EAD expires will I be able to re-enter on OPT? I might just delay but want options.
Ravi (Imm Counsel): Re-entry after OPT EAD expiry is high risk. If his H-1B COS is pending, leaving could abandon the Change of Status. We can provide a letter for consulate but likely consular processing will be required. Recommend not traveling.
Tara (Benefits): Enrollment starts on employee start date. If Luis officially starts 06/01, he has 30 days to enroll. If he needs retroactive coverage, we need exception from Benefits Leadership.
PayrollBot: Payroll note: new hire must complete I-9 within 3 days of start and provide SSN proof. Remote completion allowed if onsite within 3 days; otherwise coordinate with People Ops.
Maya (People Ops): Proposed plan: 1) Ask Luis to delay travel. 2) Offer remote-only onboarding while he stays in US. 3) Ravi to draft a provisional employment letter if consulate asks.
Luis Fernandez: I can postpone travel to June and do remote onboarding. Appreciate the letter in case plans change.
Ravi (Imm Counsel): Drafted letter below, adapt if consulate requests additional fields:
``
To Whom It May Concern,
This is to confirm that Luis Fernandez has an offer with Redwood Inference as Data Engineer with an anticipated start date of June 1, 2026. Redwood has filed an H-1B petition with USCIS and intends to support any required consular processing. For verification contact immigration@redwood.com.
``
Maya (People Ops): Thanks. I'll update the candidate's record and schedule benefits orientation in the first week. Luis, ping me once you book travel in case we need backup docs.
Tara (Benefits): FYI, if he starts and enrolls within 30 days his coverage effective date will be 06/01. No action needed now.
Luis Fernandez: Will confirm travel changes by EOD. Thanks all. :pray:
PayrollBot: Reminder: complete Form I-9 and submit direct deposit 2 days before start.
Maya (People Ops): Closing thread - outcome: candidate will delay travel, remote onboarding, benefits enrollment 06/01. Will re-open if travel booked.
